Approval Delay.riskReason: Stage-gate sign-off is pending from L2/L3 leadership, exposing the project to schedule slippage if the review isn't closed out soon.
Approval Delay.delayReason: The approval review has exceeded the standard 10-working-day SLA; the review board has not yet convened to close out the sign-off.
Approval Delay.correctiveActionDetail: Escalated to the Review Board chair; a dedicated sign-off session has been requested ahead of the next scheduled cycle.
Approval Delay.mitigationPlan: Assign a named owner to track approval status daily and pre-clear future gate reviews at least 2 weeks ahead of the target date.

Resource Gap.riskReason: Key engineering or testing resources are under-allocated relative to the plan, putting deliverable timelines at risk.
Resource Gap.delayReason: Cross-project resource contention has left this project short-staffed against its original resourcing plan.
Resource Gap.correctiveActionDetail: Team members are being reallocated from lower-priority workstreams to restore planned staffing levels.
Resource Gap.mitigationPlan: Raise a standing resourcing request with the PMO for the next sprint cycle to prevent recurrence on future gates.

Budget Overrun.riskReason: Actual spend has exceeded the approved budget envelope, risking a funding freeze on remaining deliverables.
Budget Overrun.delayReason: Cost overruns triggered a finance review, pausing further spend approval until the variance is explained.
Budget Overrun.correctiveActionDetail: A budget variance review has been escalated to the CFO's office; discretionary spend is frozen in the interim.
Budget Overrun.mitigationPlan: Rebaseline the cost plan against actuals and introduce monthly budget checkpoints for the remaining gates.

Supply Chain.riskReason: A critical component or vendor delivery is delayed, blocking downstream validation and production activities.
Supply Chain.delayReason: The primary supplier has confirmed a delivery slip, with no confirmed recovery date at this time.
Supply Chain.correctiveActionDetail: An alternative vendor is being qualified and onboarded for the affected component.
Supply Chain.mitigationPlan: Dual-source the affected component going forward and hold a minimum safety-stock buffer for critical parts.

None.riskReason: No material risk identified at this time; the project is progressing within its planned tolerance band.
None.delayReason: No delay driver recorded — current schedule variance is within the accepted 0–15 day tolerance.
None.correctiveActionDetail: No corrective action required; the project remains under standard monitoring.
None.mitigationPlan: Continue the standard monitoring cadence; re-assess if delay exceeds 15 days.
